## Overview

These are two documents I created to explain simply what my capstone project was trying to accomplish.

## Documents

::: {.file-card}
[📄 Overall Summary](../assets/pdf/overall_summary.pdf)

This is a document that explains (in plain language) the Library of Congress Subject Headings and its hierarchical structure, polysemy/homonymy, what question my capstone project addresses, my research design, and possible implications of my study. 
:::

::: {.file-card}
[📄 Summary of LCSH Authority Records and Their Graph Representation](../assets/pdf/summary_lcsh_graph.pdf)

This document explains (in plain language) what an LCSH authority record and its seven components are, what a directed graph is, how authority records are turned into a graph, and how I then measure things like hierarchical distance. 
:::
